text: MiCOM Agile P841 Line Terminal Protection | GE Vernova | Electrification
Manufacturing for the P841 has been discontinued. As an alternative, please refer to P84 MiCOM 5th Generation relay.
heading: Line Terminal Protection Systems

text: The MiCOM Agile P841 is a multifunctional line terminal IED for control and back-up protection in transmission and sub-transmission feeder bays. The P841 provides management of single or dual breaker autoreclose logic schemes with synchrocheck.
heading: Line Terminal Protection Systems

text: Extremely versatile, e.g. managing leader-follower reclosing schemes in the event of dual breaker application
heading: Key features:

text: Operator control and plant status indication facilities - 10 fully programmable function keys and tri-color LEDs
heading: Key features:

text: P841B Used for line terminals supplied by two circuit breakers, such as mesh/ring bus, double-bus, and breaker and a half feeding
heading: Models:

text: Enhanced Ethernet board module with switchable Ethernet redundancy delivered in a single model.
heading: What's New

text: The new board module is supported on P841 SW 76, 79 and 86.
heading: What's New

text: It supports PRP, HSR and RSTP in one model, allowing a single P40 model to be used in any application requiring redundant Ethernet communications. The new module is designed to handle high density traffic in the IEC 61850-8-1 network, with time latency halved. Larger architecture digital substations can also be supported, with up to 50 nodes now possible in HSR rings.
heading: What's New

text: Universal IRIG-B – Modulated and demodulated supported in the same model
heading: What's New

text: HSR Ring – Extended to 50 node support for larger substation architectures
heading: What's New

text: Fast performance, particularly in onerous applications such as where process bus GOOSE is used for tripping purposes
